title: Layoffs Explained: Why Tech Jobs Are Disappearing in 2026 | Spotlight | N18G
description:
The global tech industry is facing a major layoff wave in 2026, with more than 125,000 jobs lost so far. May was the peak, with nearly 29,000 tech jobs cut in a single month. From Amazon and Meta to Oracle and TikTok, companies are restructuring, cutting costs and investing heavily in artificial intelligence. More than two-thirds of tracked job losses are attributed to AI, while AI and machine learning skills are appearing in a growing share of US tech job postings. But behind every layoff is a person, a family and a future suddenly thrown into uncertainty. So, is your job next? Daniela Laurel explains.
